name: MONARC UI
description: Product micro-interactions that play live in a page and render to video: a button that hovers, presses, loads and lands on a check, a toggle, a like with a count, a loader that succeeds or fails, and a notification bell. Each declares its states, so <volito-player> plays them on hover and click with no setup.
